def _matches_time_range(hour: int, time_range: str) -> bool:
    bounds = _TIME_RANGES.get(time_range)
    if not bounds:
        return True
    start, end = bounds
    if start < end:
        return start <= hour < end
    else:  # wraps around midnight
        return hour >= start or hour < end
